before:
`flask.app.Flask.create_url_adapter` ignores the configured server name when
it chooses a subdomain: with `subdomain_matching` off it always uses
`url_map.default_subdomain`.
after:
`flask.app.Flask.create_url_adapter` ignores the configured server name when
it chooses a subdomain, but only when `host_matching` is also off: if
`subdomain_matching` is off, it forces the subdomain to
`url_map.default_subdomain` (falling back to `""`, not `None`). If
`host_matching` is on, this forcing is skipped entirely and `SERVER_NAME` is
dropped instead, regardless of `subdomain_matching`.
